summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software developer with over 10 years of experience, data science team member, strong advocate for salary transparency and fair compensation in tech, critical of startup culture and its compensation practices, politically progressive with a focus on social justice issues, married with two children, skeptical of traditional education paths (e.g., PhD), prefers practical experience over academic credentials, critical of tech industry’s treatment of QA and maintenance roles, interested in programming languages like Rust and C++, emphasizes the importance of code quality and testing, values work-life balance and family time over hobby projects.
